notes.title: The General Fixes Update
notes.content:
Hey there!

We are aware of an issue related to [b]Coin images not properly loading sometimes in your inventories[/b], we have been trying multiple fixes and[b] the images usually load much better now[/b]. Work is - unfortunately for us - not over yet, and [b]some of your Coins images might still not load properly[/b] on Steam. 

[b]Your Coins are of course still there in all cases[/b], you only need to [b]check back in a little while so the image can try loading again[/b]. This is an issue related to server load. 

[b]We will continue trying to deploy a final solution to this issue[/b]. If you notice any weird behaviour, as in an image loading in place of another, let us know by opening a discussion or leaving a comment providing a screeshot, [b]your feedback is valuable[/b]! ːsteamhappyː


Have a good day boys!ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: The Achievement Update Hotfix
notes.content:
Hey everybody!

After you guys let us knew yesterday of a weird behaviour with [b]fat[/b] stacks of Coins, [b]we just now figured the issue and deployed a hotfix[/b], which should be live right now, [b]making sure Coin stacks are being counted as they should[/b]. 

Please, [b]run your games for half a minute to check for achievements[/b]! 

A huge, [b]huge thanks once more for your feedback[/b], we wouldn't be here today if it weren't because of you! ːsteamthumbsupːːsteamthumbsupːːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: The Achievement Update
notes.content:
Hello there and Happy New Year 2025!

To celebrate the occasion we have done something long overdue - [b]we have reworked the achievement system, now including 12 of them![/b] ːsteamhappyː


Here is just a [b]sneak peek into some of the new[/b] (and old) [b]ones[/b]: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097718/af80e9b3238becc49dfc5378e290d877a182d6cd.png[/img]



[b]Check them all following this link: [/b]

https://steamcommunity.com/id/CoinsDev/stats/3083090/achievements/



No new Coins today boys, but [b]we are sure the achievements are gonna be equally as fun to collect![/b]

One way or the other, [b]keep collecting[/b], have a great day and year! ːsteamthumbsupː
